name: Knight · Thorn Knight
description: A guardian of the ancient forest: dark bark armour with moss-green lacquered plates, small leaves and tiny pink flowers growing from the joints, a round helm with branching antlers (one carries a leaf) and glowing green eyes in a dark visor, a teal leaf-shaped cape and a round wooden shield with a carved tree slung on his back, and a bronze leaf-bladed sword wound with a glowing vine. He walks with the sword in guard and blinks now and then; his cut lifts the sword behind the antlers, whips a bright green arc overhead and down in front, shedding leaves, and settles back to guard.
